items.problem: a pointer pressed outside the element areas is consumed while it moves across an element area, which differs from open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/virtual-pad-core.md:98 ("A pointer pressed outside the element areas ... are not consumed"). While `Active` every element has `MOUSE_FILTER_STOP`. Godot 4.7.2 has no touch focus for a pointer pressed outside all controls, so it gives that pointer's `InputEventScreenDrag` to the control under its position and marks the input handled, and `InputCore._on_unhandled_input` (client/godot/core/input_core/input_core.gd:627) does not run `_judge_move`. `_on_element_input` ignores the move because `element.pointer_id` differs. Reproduced at HEAD in a temporary copy with a test added to the module's test folder, with `LAYOUT_FIXED` open: `touch(0, true, (1000, 200))`, `drag(0, (1000, 300))` (recorder.drags is 1), `drag(0, center_of(FIRE))`. recorder.drags stays 1 where 2 is expected (`[1] expected to equal [2]`), so a world drag such as a camera drag publishes no `DragEvent` `Move` while the finger is over an element. client/godot/core/virtual_pad_core/tests/test_pointer.gd:65 only presses and releases outside the areas without moving across one, so no test covers this. Neither client/godot/core/virtual_pad_core/ nor client/godot/core/input_core/ changed in the commit range, so the range did not cause it
